name: smwmusic-ninja-gaiden-nes-game-over
title: Ninja Gaiden (NES) - Game Over
description:
Did a quick port of the Game Over jingle from Ninja Gaiden. Honestly, I think it's the best death jingle in any video game, and I will not allow my statement to be contested.

There's an option to enable or disable the SMW death SFX at the beginning:
1. Enables the Miss sound effect (turned on default)
0. Disables the Miss sound effect
